material.description: blocked_by: gap-tick-overrun-action. Live evidence (ELIMINATE, receipts/gap-tick-overrun-action/01-orient.md): (1) shedding already exists (budget.rs:16-22, room.rs step) and only defers order drains; (2) implementing the owner's paths cadence (run paths every SHED_PATHS_EVERY=4 ticks while shedding, units every tick) in tick.rs/room.rs/budget.rs and running oscraftd --ci room: at budget 1us shed engages but overruns still climb (4388/4400 ticks); at budget 22us no shed ever engages and overruns are sporadic OS noise (0-2 per 1000 ticks, 14 in 7345); the paths system is ~2-4us of a ~20us ci tick, so shed ticks are barely cheaper than full ticks. (3) Structural: a paths tick is a full-cost tick, so under any budget where full cost > budget the overrun counter keeps rising at 1/N; and the streak reset on any under-budget shed tick flaps shedding off. The acceptance 'overrun count stops increasing' is not reachable by a bounded paths cadence. Edits reverted to HEAD e6d39a16; nothing pushed. Needed owner decision: change the acceptance to a rate bound, add hysteresis, or shed a heavier pass (e.g. Units or Vision) in a loaded catalog.
material.subject: Shed paths cadence cannot witness the overrun-stops-climbing acceptance
material.witness: Blocker closed by rescope of gap-tick-overrun-action (mean-rate acceptance). CI run 39101571236 (head 9a29aa8), job 'tick shed window': 'average overrun rate over 5 pairs (report only): shed=off 0.2341 shed=on 0.1866' (dispatch 1792302671115-500-b8d7a14a5549ace9). Mean shed-on rate is lower than mean shed-off rate.
material.witness_plan: Measure full-cost vs shed-cost on a loaded catalog with the chosen acceptance; witness overrun count across fixed windows.
